subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should persistent multi-agent workspace context remain in the Dashboard header breadcrumb, or should this PR be rewritten around the no-breadcrumb header direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101017?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested workspace header context, but this branch conflicts with the refactored UI and an open member-authored draft removes the same breadcrumb surface; automation cannot choose the final header contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep the focused workspace breadcrumb direction, port it onto the current app-topbar/dashboard-header surface, and track optional switcher or prefix UX separately.

options.title: Adopt No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR and redesign persistent multi-agent/workspace certainty in the surface chosen by the no-breadcrumb header work.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require switch feedback or stronger live-target proof before any focused breadcrumb implementation can close the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep the focused workspace breadcrumb direction, port it onto the current app-topbar/dashboard-header surface, and track optional switcher or prefix UX separately.

likelyOwner.reason: vyctorbrzezowski owns the open member-authored draft that changes the same header/breadcrumb product direction this PR depends on.
